dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly falcate trailing edge characterized by a smooth, deep concave spline curvature from the sub-apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological classification with a moderate pixel radius curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small depigmented notch or temporal mark on the trailing edge just below the apex; cluster of white punctate markings or skin lesions on the lower anterior region of the fin.
